We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly the system expects we retrieve NMR spectra and infer methyl groups? But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be previous context? No prior info. We may need to request proton NMR to see methyl peaks. But we don't know molecule. Could be that the tool will give spectra for "sample at hand" which is predetermined. So we can call proton_nmr_spectra to get 1H NMR, then count methyl signals (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). But need to interpret. Could also use carbon NMR to see methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Simpler: use proton NMR.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
